exclusions: every group with a v1 hold-out row (spent) or a v1 cached page (v2 was tuned on those)
all_rows_holdout: nothing is tuned on this set; the evaluation runs once
pages: per row the input URL and its first follow (core/detect followTarget: board iframe, else same-domain careers link), fetched from the PC by bench/detect/fetch-pages.mjs: one request at a time, >= 1.5 s apart, robots.txt strict, budget 600 requests; pinned by sha1 in bench/detect/split-v2.pages.jsonl before any v2 run
headline: two-page tier: v1 = detectV1 on page 1, else on the follow page when page 1 gives no provider; v2 = detect() over the same cached pages (its own follow rule). Macro-F1 over multi-tenant ATS classes seen in labels or predictions, custom rows as negatives; paired bootstrap 2000, seed 12345
secondary: rows tagged stand_in (config names an ATS) reported separately
post-hoc diagnostic: custom rows where v1 and v2 name the same ATS
decision: v2 becomes the CLI/MCP default only if the lower bound of the headline gap (v2 - v1) is > 0; otherwise v1 stays
